question: Should this PR require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before merge, or is the focused helper-level timing proof enough for maintainers to accept the session-state risk?
rationale: Static source review can confirm the changed cleanup boundary, but it cannot prove the user-visible Feishu/gateway scheduling path without real runner evidence.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu DM run, runner logs, or comparable production-runner transcript showing the real result persists without the synthetic missing-result error before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level timing proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on the focused race tests and current source inspection while owning the unproven live-channel timing risk.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 until someone can produce real transport or runner proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu DM run, runner logs, or comparable production-runner transcript showing the real result persists without the synthetic missing-result error before merge.
